scenes.event: Group decision about attending a late-night party
scenes.location: A cozy coffee shop near the university
scenes.description: Ella, Lora, and Lili are gathered at a small table in the corner of the coffee shop, discussing a party invitation. Lora is visibly distant, while Lili is quietly worried. Ella is trying to balance her care for Lora with the group's desire to have fun.

characters.name: Ella Turner
characters.description: 21-year-old college student, warm and empathetic, trying to keep her friends together while ensuring their safety.; 21-year-old /Female/Social Group Member, 24 years old; Occupation: College Student; Personality: Caring, Determined, Empathetic; Values: Friendship, Safety, Responsibility; Interests: Social Gatherings, Team Activities, Helping Others; Experiences: Participating in Team Sports, Handling Interpersonal Conflicts, Organizing Social Activities
characters.position: Seated at the center of the table

characters.name: Lora Smith
characters.description: 24-year-old friend of Ella's, recently distant and independent, insists on going alone despite the group's objections; Female; Age: 24; Occupation: Graduate student in psychology; Personality: Analytical, reserved, self-reliant; Values: Autonomy, personal growth; Interests: Journaling, indie music, quiet evenings at home; Experiences: Recently ended a long-term relationship, started therapy to process past trauma, feeling pressure to meet social expectations.

characters.name: Lili Chen
characters.description: Lili Chen; Female; Age: 22; Occupation: Psychology major; Personality: Thoughtful, empathetic, introverted; Values: Safety, loyalty, emotional well-being; Interests: Reading self-help books, journaling, nature walks; Experiences: Witnessed a close friend struggle with anxiety at a similar social event, often acts as a quiet mediator in group conflicts.

actions.action: Tries to persuade Lora to stay with the group
actions.dialogue: Lora, I just don't feel comfortable if you go alone. It's not worth the risk, you know that. We can all go together and make sure you're safe.
Ella, I appreciate the concern, but I need to do this on my own. I'm not a child, and I can handle myself.
She hasn't been herself lately. I'm worried she's not thinking clearly.

actions.action: Pauses, visibly torn between her values and Lora's wishes
actions.dialogue: I just... I don't want anything to happen to you. If you're sure, I'll respect that. But if you need us, we're here, okay?
Thanks, Ella. I know you're just trying to help. I'll be fine, I promise.

scenes.plot: Ella is trying to convince Lora not to go to a late-night party alone, but Lora is insistent. Lili supports Ella but also shows concern for Lora. The group's dynamic is tested as they struggle to find a balance between respecting Lora's wishes and ensuring her safety.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate Ella's values of friendship, safety, and responsibility, and how she navigates interpersonal conflict and group dynamics while caring for her friends.

chunk.text: Ella, Lora, and Lili are discussing a party invitation in a coffee shop. Lora insists on going alone, and Ella is trying to convince her otherwise. Lili supports Ella but is also worried about Lora's well-being.
